scheme_name: Grant of Incentive to the Family having One Girl/Two Girl Children and Parents who have undergone Family Planning
other_conditions: Both parents must be Indian citizens
Either parent must be a native of Puducherry by birth or have resided continuously for at least five years
Father must be at least 21 years old and mother at least 18 years old at the time of marriage
The parents must have undergone Family Planning in a Central/State Government Hospital or a registered private hospital
The family must have only one or two girl children
The marriage of the applicant must be registered with the appropriate authority
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹30,000 for one girl child or ₹15,000 per child for two girls, deposited in the child’s name and released when the child turns 18 years old.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
